title: aglaia rufinervis
intro: Aglaia rufinervis, commonly known as the Philippine or Borneo aglaia, is a plant species in the Meliaceae family, native to the tropical forests of the Philippines and Borneo. The health benefits of Aglaia rufinervis include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor properties, which can help alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an antimalarial, antifungal, and antihelmintic agent, as well as its potential in treating infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Aglaia rufinervis include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
